name: Meow Lab 2 — Modern-Retro Cat Studio
intent: Make Meow Lab 2 feel like Rosey's own playable retro music hardware: distinctive drawn cat musicians, an inviting performance surface and readable sixteen-bar music tools. Source receipts and audio behavior remain independent of the presentation.

witnesses.notes: Direct source audit found mixed purple/teal skins, a generic smiling SVG cat, four emoji cat selectors and imported-sound language using 'swallow'.
Sibling playable instrument establishes Rosey's playful cat-music identity and accessible keyboard behavior, not a copy target.
Executable witness for keyboard, sound import, download, storage, 16-bar navigation and melody pinning; presentation must not break these interactions.

grammar.layout: Single strong instrument headline and animated illustration, then sound bank, cat selection/keyboard, recording, melody and arrangement tools; mobile stacks without hiding capabilities.
grammar.hierarchy: Simple musician flow: make a groove, select four chords repeated across 16 bars, then draw one of 8 looping melody bars; detailed per-bar forms are behind optional disclosures.
grammar.density: Expressive poster-like top section; compact, labeled workstation controls where editing requires precision.
grammar.controls: Clear four-chord preview and explicit song-level apply; independent groove control and tempo; audible pink ▶ NOW melody versus mint EDIT melody; 16-bar selection and playhead remain separate. Optional per-bar cadence, layers and backups.
grammar.surface: Flat midnight-plum ink, cream, peach, mint and lilac; small grid, hard offset shadows, cassette/arcade labels. No stock imagery, glossy AI gradient cards or branded assets.
grammar.typography: Friendly heavyweight display lettering for personality; high-contrast monospace for musical state and evidence data.
grammar.illustration: Original hand-built cat DJ with headphones, star badge and waveform-ready animation, plus four CSS-drawn miniature face marks; colors track selected voice.
grammar.motion: Independent looping stage motion: notes travel across and upward through the scene, eight hand-drawn pixel sparks orbit on offset routes, and a scrolling retro grid slowly moves at idle. Live held notes trigger quicker flights, a dancing cat, and animated equalizer bars. Reduced-motion preference removes movement without hiding instrument state.
grammar.evidence: Imported browser audio shows local-file receipt and remains unverified; only native workstation handoff can produce independent execution evidence.

avoid: generic emoji as primary character identity
borrowed verbs that hide import semantics
screenshot copying or unlicensed character art
adaptation_rules: Preserve all current sound synthesis, sample import, source manifests, download and native handoff behavior.
Keep the thirteen-note keyboard, sixteen chord bars, eight melody bars, saved branches and per-bar cadence semantics intact.
Use plain source verbs: import into a browser slot, export a WAV/manifest, and admit to a native worker; never collapse these distinct events.
Draw the cat characters locally; do not import emoji illustrations, stock mascots, trademarks or proprietary sound assets.
Expose song-state and selected cat states in text and aria attributes, not solely through color.
Honor narrow mobile layouts and reduced motion.
Keep visual verification provisional until screenshot review and Chromium interaction checks pass.
Stage particles must remain decoration only (pointer-events none, aria-hidden); performance state uses existing held-note lifecycle, with no added audio workers or background polling.
Preserve separate state for playingBar/loopLast, selected chord bar and pinned melodyEditIndex, with accurate audible and edit labels.
Changing chord loop/key only previews until explicit apply, and applying changes only chord values, never grooves, melody or cadence.

review.notes: Beat-first source audit and Chromium regression tests added October 22, 2026; no new audio capabilities claimed. Visual sign-off remains candidate pending screenshot review.
